question_fr: Films qui se déroulent dans des lieux imaginaires
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o (gpt-6-sol since 2026-10-01) through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.MOVIE_TITLE, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.DAT_RELEASE, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_IMDB, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IMDB_RATING, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IMDB_VOTES, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.POSTER_PATH, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.RUNTIME, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.TAGLINE, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_CRITERION_SPINE FROM T_WC_T2S_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_LOCATION ON T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION WHERE T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.LOCATION_ROLE = 'narrative' AND T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.LOCATION_TYPE = 'fiction' AND T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.DELETED = 0 ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED DESC LIMIT 15
comment: EVALUATIONS-024. A LOCATION_TYPE other than city: 575 living places are typed fiction. The Dark Knight (Gotham City), The Empire Strikes Back (Hoth, Dagobah, Bespin) and Back to the Future (Hill Valley) are set in one.
